title: BT51032: Nano Biotechnology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to Nanosciences and Nanotechnologies. Micro- and nanofabrication;
Micromachining: MEMS NEMS; BioMEMS; Scanning probe techniques (SPM);
biosensors and lab-on-a-chip. Molecular Nanotechnology: principles of selfassembly and self-organization of Chemistry - supramolecular structures; Carbon
nanotubes; Nanoparticles and nanowires; polymeric nanocontainers for drug
delivery. Nanobiomachines; Structural principles of Nanobiotechnology;
Functional principles of Nan biotechnology; Protein-based nanostructures; DNAbased nanostructures; Nanoanalysis and nanobiosensors; the future of
Nanobiotechnology
